The top bar

  • 1Back. One step back. Hidden once cards are dealt, so a round can't be thrown away.
  • 2Counter. Which player or page you're on.
  • 3Padlock. Shows when the lock is on. Shut, nothing else responds.
  • 4Home. Back to the menu.
  • 5Settings. Opens settings, then brings you back here.

Settings

Tap the sliders icon. Six tiles:

Light

Brightness, 10 steps.

Theme

9 color themes. Mono is easiest to read in bright sun.

Battery

The charge, and Power saver.

Tips

Says “Locked. Tap the padlock.” when someone taps a locked screen.

Lock

Off, Manual or Auto.

Screen

Flip it to read from the other side, like when a cable's in the way.

The lock

Stops bumps while the box goes around. Set it with the Lock tile.

Off

Nothing locks.

Manual

You lock and unlock it.

Auto

Locks each time someone taps Next.

Locked, waiting for the next player

Looks frozen?

It's locked. Tap the padlock at the top.

It only locks while cards are being passed. The talk and play screens never lock. Turning it on or off asks you to confirm.

Battery and sleep

  • ChargingAny USB-C phone charger. It says Charging while plugged in.
  • SleepDims after 1 minute, off after 10. Tap to wake it right where you were.
  • Power saverOn the battery screen. Dims after 30 seconds, off after 5 minutes.
  • Low batteryA red badge on the menu at 20%.

Care

  • It has a built-in lithium battery. Don't crush, puncture or open the case.
  • Keep it dry. It isn't water resistant.
  • Don't leave it in a hot car or direct sun.
  • Don't leave it charging unattended. Slightly warm while charging is normal. If it gets hot, unplug it and message me.
  • For ages 10 and up.
